title: Rational Homology Ribbon Cobordism is a Partial Order
summary: We prove that rational homology ribbon cobordism defines a partial order on the set of homeomorphism classes of closed, connected, oriented 3-manifolds. More precisely, if $W_0 \leq W_1$ and $W_1 \leq W_0$, then $W_0$ and $W_1$ are homeomorphic by an orientation preserving homeomorphism.
